sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A Cuban tree reaching about 5–6 m, found in forest and shrubland formations from 0 to 700 m elevation.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The leaves are about 2.3–4.5 × 1–2.7 cm. Axillary yellow-brown flowers are funnel-shaped; orange-yellow fruits are about 1.5–2.3 cm long. Taxonomic treatments differ on its family: Solanaceae at Kew, Goetzeaceae in the cited Cuban flora.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented in the sources consulted.
